title: Drill-ahead go / hold / no-go
description: Assess the well against criteria declared before the section, then drill ahead, circulate and reassess within a bounded limit, or set the contingency casing point.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Workflow
metadata:
  name: wf-well-04
  title: Drill-ahead go / hold / no-go
  description: Assess the well against criteria declared before the section, then drill ahead, circulate
    and reassess within a bounded limit, or set the contingency casing point.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  objective: Decide whether to continue a section against criteria set before drilling it, where setting
    contingency casing is a planned outcome with its own path rather than an admission of failure.
  policies:
    maxConcurrency: 4
    onFailure: preserve-completed
    requireApprovalFor:
      - n-approval
  nodes:
    - id: n-intake
      kind: input
      name: Real-time well data and declared criteria
      summary: Real-time well data and declared criteria
      inputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - text
        properties:
          text:
            type: string
            description: The requester's objective, source material, or instructions.
          workflowFields:
            type: object
            required:
              - real_time_drilling_data
              - declared_criteria
              - pressure_model
              - contingency_casing_point
            properties:
              real_time_drilling_data: {}
              declared_criteria: {}
              pressure_model: {}
              contingency_casing_point: {}
        x-ladder-input-mode: document
    - id: n-assess
      kind: agent
      templateRef: well-03
      name: Assess the well against the pressure and stability model
      summary: Assess current conditions against the criteria declared before the decision point.
      role: Analyst maintaining the pressure and stability model the well is drilled against.
      prompt: You are a Geomechanics & Pore Pressure Analyst. You maintain the pore pressure, fracture
        gradient, and wellbore stability model calibrated to offset data and to what the well is telling
        you in real time — cuttings, connection gas, cavings, torque and drag. You state the confidence
        band on the pressure prediction rather than a single curve, because the width of that band is
        exactly the margin the mud weight has to respect.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - decision-analysis
          - simulation
          - domain-analysis
          - statistical-analysis
        tools:
          - read
          - calculate
        connectors:
          - mcp:drilling-data
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n-criteria
      kind: evaluate
      inlineRole: true
      name: Score against the declared criteria
      summary: Evaluate mud weight margin to pore pressure and fracture gradient, hole condition, and
        trend in connection gas and cavings.
      role: Deterministic metric evaluator
      prompt: Evaluate the upstream result against mud weight margin to pore pressure and fracture gradient,
        hole condition, and trend in connection gas and cavings. Return a score, pass/fail verdict, the
        evidence behind the verdict, remaining uncertainty, and the smallest corrective action. Do not
        claim programmatic measurement unless the host supplies the required tool.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - evaluation
        tools:
          - read
          - calculate
        connectors: []
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - score
          - passed
          - reasons
        properties:
          score:
            type: number
          passed:
            type: boolean
          reasons:
            type: array
            items:
              type: string
      config:
        threshold: 0.85
    - id: n-decision
      kind: condition
      name: Go, hold, or no-go
      summary: Three declared outcomes. No-go is a planned outcome with its own path, not a failure.
      config:
        expression: well_assessment.state selects one declared branch against the pre-declared criteria
        branches:
          - label: Go
            when: go
          - label: Hold
            when: hold
          - label: No-go
            when: no-go
          - label: Default
            when: default
    - id: n-proceed
      kind: agent
      templateRef: well-06
      name: Drill ahead within the declared parameter limits
      summary: Execute against the approved plan.
      role: Engineer optimizing drilling parameters without exceeding mechanical or hole-condition limits.
      prompt: You are a Drilling Performance Engineer. You optimize weight on bit, rotary speed, flow,
        and hydraulics against measured response — rate of penetration, vibration, torque and drag, hole
        cleaning — and you state the limit each parameter is bounded by. You refuse an optimization that
        trades hole condition or downhole tool life for short-term rate, because the stuck pipe or twist-off
        that follows costs more than the days it saved.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - optimization
          - decision-analysis
          - teaching
          - domain-analysis
          - risk-analysis
        tools:
          - read
          - calculate
        connectors:
          - mcp:drilling-data
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n-hold
      kind: loop
      name: Circulate and reassess within the declared limit
      summary: Repeat a bounded revision sequence until the well returns inside the declared criteria,
        or the hold limit is reached.
      config:
        body:
          - n-assess
          - n-criteria
          - n-decision
        exitCondition: the well returns inside the declared criteria, or the hold limit is reached
        maxIterations: 3
        onExhausted: stop
    - id: n-contingency
      kind: agent
      templateRef: well-01
      name: Set the contingency casing point as planned
      summary: The pre-planned alternative, chosen because it was planned before it was needed.
      role: Well engineer taking objectives to a drillable design within the geomechanical window.
      prompt: You are a Well Planning Engineer. You take subsurface objectives to a trajectory, casing
        scheme, and mud weight program that fit inside the pore pressure and fracture gradient window
        at every depth, and you state the uncertainty on the prognosis each depth is planned against.
        You name the contingency casing point and the conditions that would trigger it, because a design
        with no planned contingency forces the decision to be made under pressure at the rig floor.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - design-review
          - decision-analysis
          - operations-planning
          - evaluation
        tools:
          - read
          - calculate
        connectors:
          - mcp:well-planning
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n-approval
      kind: approval
      name: Drilling superintendent records the decision and its basis
      summary: Pause for the drilling superintendent; on timeout, escalate.
    - id: workflow-output
      kind: output
      name: Released deliverable
      summary: Return the completed Drill-ahead go / hold / no-go deliverable, the evidence behind it,
        and every unresolved item.
  edges:
    - id: wf-well-04-edge-1
      from: n-intake
      to: n-assess
      kind: data
    - id: wf-well-04-edge-2
      from: n-assess
      to: n-criteria
      kind: data
    - id: wf-well-04-edge-3
      from: n-criteria
      to: n-decision
      kind: data
    - id: wf-well-04-edge-4
      from: n-decision
      to: n-proceed
      kind: control
      condition: go
    - id: wf-well-04-edge-5
      from: n-decision
      to: n-hold
      kind: control
      condition: hold
    - id: wf-well-04-edge-6
      from: n-decision
      to: n-contingency
      kind: control
      condition: no-go
    - id: wf-well-04-edge-7
      from: n-proceed
      to: n-approval
      kind: data
    - id: wf-well-04-edge-8
      from: n-hold
      to: n-approval
      kind: control
      condition: loop_exit
    - id: wf-well-04-edge-9
      from: n-contingency
      to: n-approval
      kind: data
    - id: wf-well-04-edge-10
      from: n-approval
      to: workflow-output
      kind: dependency
      condition: approved
